data.name: Iman
data.gender_notes: Iman is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Iman is an Islamic name of Arabic origin, meaning 'faith' or 'belief'. The name Iman carries the meaning “Faith, Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iman usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Iman signifies firm belief and unwavering trust in Allah, the prophets, and the Day of Judgment.
data.etymology: Iman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iman total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: إيمان
in_arabic.meaning: الإيمان بالله والرسول والكتاب والحساب والقدر
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإيمان هو التصديق بالجزم واليقين بالله تعالى وبرسوله وبالكتاب الذي أنزل عليه وبالحساب والقدر خيره وشره، وهو أصل الدين الإسلامي ومفتاح قبول الأعمال الصالحة

in_urdu.name: ایمان
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ اور اس کے رسول پر یقین و تصدیق
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمان کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ اور اس کے رسول پر پکا یقین و تصدیق کرنا، اور قرآن کریم کی حقانیت کو مانتے ہوئے آخرت کے دن اور تقدیر کی اچھی باتوں کو قبول کرنا، اسلامی عقیدے کی بنیاد

in_hindi.name: ईमान
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान और उसके दूत पर विश्वास
in_hindi.long_meaning: ईमान का अर्थ है अल्लाह और उसके दूत पर दृढ़ विश्वास करना, और कुरआन की सच्चाई को स्वीकार करते हुए अच्छे और बुरे भाग्य को मानना, इस्लामी धर्म की मूल बात

in_pashto.name: ایمان
in_pashto.meaning: الله او د هغه د رسول پر باور
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمان د الله تعالی او د هغه د رسول پر قوي باور دی، او د قرآن د حقیت منلو سره د آخرت د حساب او تقدیر ښه والی او بدی منل، د اسلامي مذهب اساس

in_english.name: Iman
in_english.meaning: Faith and belief in Allah and His Messenger
in_english.long_meaning: Iman refers to the firm belief and conviction in Allah, the Almighty, and His Messenger. It encompasses acceptance of the Quran as the divine word, belief in the hereafter, and acknowledgment of divine decree. It is the foundational element of Islam, signifying trust and acceptance of God's guidance

The name Iman serves as a constant reminder of one's commitment to their faith and the importance of maintaining it throughout their life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that She is also known as Umm Ayman or Umm Iman. The name Iman carried significant weight in that era.
